items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: they said there hadn't been any colored musicians there since Josephine Baker, which was about 25 years before.

ctx.x: So they gave me a new approach. And our tour of toured Sweden with a tremendous success, because we were -- people said that we were the first -- in some parts -- well, Jimmy Lunceford has preceded us, in this tour to Sweden, but he hadn't been to Finland. But when we went to Finland and they said there hadn't been any colored musicians there since Josephine Baker, which was about 25 years before.
